商议并未持续太久，既然已经确定了前往桃源古镇的方向，众人便不再耽搁，立刻着手收拾行装。

李二牛手脚麻利，很快就将众人的行囊收拾妥当，杨树远缓缓说道：

“我研究杨家古籍多年，上面记载过一些关于桃源古镇的零星记载，只是太过简略，此次一同前往，或许能从中找到一些线索。而且阴尘阁当年与杨家有过勾连，这件事说不定就与杨家的过往有关，我必须去一趟查清真相，也算是给杨家一个交代。”

众人闻言，都没有异议，毕竟杨树远对玄门秘闻和阴尘阁的了解，远胜于他们，有他在无疑多了一份保障。

一切准备就绪后，众人一同走出小院，李二牛早已将车开到门口，一辆黑色的越野车，车身结实，适合走山路，正是为此次出行特意准备的。

众人依次上车，胡九郎和杨童坐在副驾驶和后座靠窗的位置，杨树远坐在后座中间，范梦雪、苏笑笑和阡陌则坐在后排，李二牛发动车子，越野车缓缓驶离小院，朝着桃源古镇的方向疾驰而去。

车内一时有些安静，每个人都在思索着此次出行的目的，空气中弥漫着一丝凝重的气息。

杨童望着窗外飞速倒退的风景，脑海中反复回放着幻境中的画面，前世的她，身着白衣，眉眼温婉，与胡九郎相守相伴，可最终却落得个殉情的下场，她实在想不明白，自己当年到底是出于什么苦衷，才会做出背叛胡九郎的举动，而这一切，又与阴尘阁的阴谋、上古邪物有什么关联。

胡九郎察觉到她的心神不宁，伸手握住她的手，轻声说道：

“别想太多，一切都会水落石出的。”

杨童转头看向他，点了点头，心中的不安渐渐消散。

车子行驶了半天，早已远离了市区，进入了郊外的山路。

长时间的行驶，众人也渐渐感到疲惫，李二牛看了看仪表盘，说道：

“前面有个服务区，我们进去休息一下，加个油买点干粮和水，再继续赶路。”

众人纷纷点头，长时间的车程，确实需要休息片刻。

越野车缓缓驶入服务区，服务区不算太大，却也五脏俱全，有加油站、便利店和休息区。

The discussion did not last long. Now that the direction to Taoyuan Ancient Town had been determined, everyone stopped delaying and immediately started packing.

Li Erniu was quick with his hands and feet and quickly packed everyone's luggage. Yang Shuyuan said slowly:

"I have studied the ancient books of the Yang family for many years, and there are some sporadic records about Taoyuan Ancient Town recorded in them, but they are too brief. If we go together this time, we may be able to find some clues. Moreover, Yinchen Pavilion had a connection with the Yang family back then. This matter may be related to the past of the Yang family. I must go to find out the truth, which can also be regarded as an explanation to the Yang family."

Everyone heard the words and had no objections. After all, Yang Shuyuan's understanding of the secrets of Xuanmen and Yinchen Pavilion was far better than theirs. Having him there was undoubtedly an added guarantee.

After everything was ready, everyone walked out of the courtyard together. Li Erniu had already driven to the door. A black off-road vehicle with a strong body and suitable for walking on mountain roads was specially prepared for this trip.

Everyone got in the car one by one. Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong sat in the passenger seat and the back seat by the window. Yang Shuyuan sat in the middle of the back seat. Fan Mengxue, Su Xiaoxiao and Qian Mo sat in the back seat. Li Erniu started the car, and the off-road vehicle slowly left the courtyard and sped towards the Taoyuan Ancient Town.

The car was a little quiet for a while, everyone was thinking about the purpose of this trip, and there was a solemn atmosphere in the air.

Yang Tong looked at the rapidly retreating scenery outside the window and replayed the scenes in the fantasy repeatedly in her mind. In her previous life, she was dressed in white, with gentle eyebrows, and stayed with Hu Jiulang, but in the end she died for her love. She really couldn't figure out why she had betrayed Hu Jiulang, and how all this was related to the Yinchen Pavilion's conspiracy and ancient evil things.

Hu Jiulang noticed that she was restless, reached out to hold her hand, and said softly:

"Don't think too much, everything will fall into place."

Yang Tong turned to look at him and nodded, the uneasiness in his heart gradually dissipating.

After driving for a long time, the car had already left the urban area and entered the mountain roads in the suburbs.

After driving for a long time, everyone gradually felt tired. Li Erniu looked at the dashboard and said:

"There is a service area ahead. Let's go in and take a rest, fill up with gas and buy some dry food and water before we continue on our way."

Everyone nodded, after a long drive, they really needed a break.

The off-road vehicle slowly drove into the service area. The service area was not too big, but it was well-equipped with gas stations, convenience stores and rest areas.
